title: Meta-Aligner: Bidirectional Preference-Policy Optimization for Multi-Objective LLMs Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on multi-objective alignment of LLMs with human values, specifically 'helpfulness' and 'harmlessness'. These represent ethical and moral frameworks for AI behavior. The study includes qualitative analysis of how the model handles sensitive societal and moral questions (e.g., treatment of criminals), which falls under the evaluation of ethics and moral reasoning in AI.
